content: Note to reviewers: this clash may potentially be similar to https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/9512ee203267a89e4592a9d0015dafb0625

General
* Contributions must be written in English according to the contribution guidelines.

* Please study and follow the example here: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement .

Input
* Please remove all the possible inputs from this section.

Output
* Please remove the example from this section.

Constraints
* Please add a constraint on the length of the input (lower and upper bounds).

Stub generator
* Please change "resultat" to "result".

Cases
* Each test and its validator should not be the same. They should cover the same scenario, with similar inputs and outputs. Please revise Validators 1 to 3.

Thanks.

Thanks, 

I'm a beginner, i'll change it all according to the guidelines and your advice :)
No problem! Just let me know when you've updated the contribution 🙂
Should be ok, it's a very simple one, maybe already existing. I just wanted to try and see how it works.

I haven't found any existing clashes where the task is to reverse the input string yet.

Input / Constraints / Stub generator
* If the variable name is "firstName", please:

  • include that in the Input section,

  • format "firstName" as a [[variable]] in both the Input and Constraints sections, and

  • use the same name in the stub generator.

Cases
* Test 4 and Validator 4 violate the description in the Goal and Input sections, as "&" isn't an uppercase letter.

Thanks.
